summary: High-quality analysis with accurate code research, well-differentiated options, and a sound recommendation. All 10 code references verified as exactly correct (line numbers, function names, behavior descriptions). The three remote-sync options and three schema-migration options address meaningfully different trade-offs. The recommendation of phase-boundary pushing (Option C) is well-justified given the write-frequency constraint, and pre-validation sanitization (Option I) is a pragmatic choice for schema compat. Seven open questions are specific, actionable, and address genuine ambiguities.
